items.title: US officially loses measles elimination status, PAHO says
items.summary: The U.S. on Tuesday officially lost its measles elimination status for the first time since it gained this distinction more than 25 years ago, with a count of more than 7,700 cases in the past two years and more than 10 deaths reported by states since 2025. The announcement comes as the country faces its highest number of measles infections in more than three decades, with more than 7,700 cases and 13 deaths reported since 2025.
